plan.thesis: In an established uptrend (close above its 50-day and 200-day averages), a multi-day pullback of more than 2% sets up a favorable rebound toward the +5% target before the -3% stop.

objections: cautious hit rate 35.9% (95% lower bound; plain 47.1% over 70 setups) is not above the 37.5% break-even
